_comment: Copy to tables/resources.json (git-ignored; holds real SSH targets / tailnet addresses) and edit, then point the router at it with CORTADOS_LOCAL_RESOURCES_CONFIG. Each node is sampled over SSH (target 'local' means this machine); the collector reports unified/VRAM memory and GPU headroom. 'inventory' is documentation only. 'deployments' stays empty until a model is verified on real hardware (see docs/LOCAL-RESOURCES.md). Addresses here are placeholders.

nodes._comment: No ollama block: the Studio runs S1 only and offers no chat models (owner 2026-11-13, #75).

ollama._comment: Local models live on the Pro only (#75; owner 2026-11-13: the Studio runs S1, no chat models). The URL is the Pro's local gate (http://<pro tailscale-ip>:11435), from the env var named here (or base_url); the token file path likewise. Never commit a real address or token. The gate refuses on battery or with the manual switch off (local_resources toggle), and the lane is skipped then. The models are the ones already on the Pro (owner 2026-11-13: nothing is downloaded for the router). auto_route (the manual band rule) stays false: superseded by the published proxy index (owner 2026-11-13), which offers Qwen27b_heretic wherever its index qualifies (index_route, default true; max_inflight, default 1, makes the node busy; docs/LOCAL-RESOURCES.md, Local models in selection). A config that still sets auto_route keeps working; it is checked first. context_length must not exceed the Pro's OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH. Each model may set thinking: "off-unless-asked" (the default: a request that did not ask for thinking is sent with thinking disabled, #108) or "passthrough".
ollama.label: Pro

sensitive._comment: Sensitive requests (docs/LOCAL-RESOURCES.md, Sensitive requests): x-cortados-local: sensitive|prefer, a match in the keyword list, or (refusal_fallback) a cloud refusal of an opening turn may run on this model in any band, only with no effect outside the machine. Absent = off. The keyword list lives on the provider host only (format: tables/sensitive-keywords.example.txt); never commit real terms. keywords_file_env, when set, names an env var holding the path instead.
